description: Defines the LineNumberProgram class for parsing and handling DWARF debug line information in the torch::unwind namespace.

classes.name: LineNumberProgram
classes.description: Handles parsing and interpreting DWARF debug line information, including reading section headers, directories, files, and program instructions.

methods.name: LineNumberProgram
methods.description: Constructor initializing with Sections reference and offset.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the debug line program data from the section.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds a program entry by address.

methods.name: filename
methods.description: Constructs filename from directory index and file name.

methods.name: skipForm
methods.description: Skips over a form in the data based on its size.

methods.name: produceEntry
methods.description: Adds current address and line info to ranges.

methods.name: endSequence
methods.description: Ends a sequence and stores the program range.

methods.name: readProgram
methods.description: Reads and interprets the program instructions.
